_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 日神之使振翼盘旋于云端，神眸洞彻四野潜匿之敌，并以此辉光引领王师锐不可当。
desc.en: The Sun Deity's herald wheels above the clouds on beating wings; its divine eyes lay bare every foe lurking across the land, and by this radiance it leads the royal host forward, irresistible.

desc.zh: 即使是最强大的敌人，也无法在身受重伤时屹立，而且所受伤害越大，他们的战斗力就会越为低下
desc.en: Even the greatest foes can be laid low with terrible injuries, and the greater the damage done, the less able they will be to effectively continue the fray.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以对所有敌军部队引发恐惧，令附近敌军遭受领导力惩罚。同时这支部队自身也对恐惧效果免疫。恐惧惩罚不能叠加
desc.en: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

desc.zh: 这支部队可惊骇敌军，令其近战目标溃逃一段时间。对于能够造成惊骇的部队来说，其自身也将免疫恐惧与惊骇效果
desc.en: This unit can cause terror, making its melee target rout for a short time. Units that cause terror are immune to terror and fear themselves.
